population.definition: ALL residential schemes with >=10 units decided in 2024-2025 in the national register

model_split: frozen artifact (national_residential_v4_full), trained exclusively on pre-2024 data; 2024-2025 was never seen in training

fisher_exact_test.interpretation: probability the top-vs-bottom separation is chance

risk_ratio_top_vs_bottom.note: Haldane continuity correction applied if a cell is zero

headline_auc_8020.note: v4-full on the two-year modern-regime holdout
